[[File:Icon-Interrupt.png|40px]]

An '''Interrupt''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type played from hand for a one-time action. After it is played it is placed in the Used Pile or the Lost Pile, according to whether it is a [[Used Interrupt]] or a [[Lost Interrupt]].

[[Sense]] and [[Alter]] can cancel an Interrupt as it is played. Interrupts are not [[Effect]]s and are not canceled by Alter's Effect-canceling function.

Premiere examples: [[Alter]], [[Sense]], [[Utinni!]], [[Don't Get Cocky]].
